Librogame.title: The 40th Thief
Librogame.author: Matteo Borghesi

Changes.Change: Adapted for this app: the structure, the rules and parts of the text were changed or removed to work with its engine
Translated into English from the original Italian
Added sounds and background music, delivered together with the book

Librogame.ContentWarnings: Theft, a time paradox that destroys the universe, and a giant bird of prey that carries someone off for dinner. All of it played for laughs.
Librogame.Blurb:
You are Amir, the last of the forty thieves, the one who gets all the worst jobs. The chief has left his scimitar in the cave and sends you to fetch it.
You arrive just in time to hear "Close, Sesame!" and to see a man riding off into the desert loaded with riches. It is Ali Baba, and he has taken the road to the Sultan's palace. If he gets there, you are all finished.

Variable.name: Ali Baba is carrying the birdseed

Page.Text:
You are Amir, the last of the forty thieves, the outcast of the band who gets all the worst jobs. After yet another raid, the chief realises he has left his scimitar inside the cave and, so as not to waste time on the raids in the diary, decides to send you to fetch it. You are heading grumpily for the cave when a voice makes you jump: — Close, Sesame! —
What is going on? A man on his dromedary is riding off into the desert loaded with riches: it is Ali Baba, and he has just taken the path that leads to the Sultan's palace. You must stop him before he reveals the hiding place to the royal guards!
Ali Baba has a good head start. It will be hard to catch him.

Page.Text: It is the annual subscription to the Rentalcarpet flying-carpet hire service. Without asking yourself any questions, you go to the nearest branch and collect a fine 8-cylinder twin-turbo carpet. Now you have a flying carpet.

As you pass by, you slip the object away with the ease of the professional you are. Who knows whether the legend is true? You rub the lamp and a Genie comes out of it: — Greetings, master. I am here to… —
— Grant my wishes? —
— No, I only have the power to take you back in time. Call me when you need it. —

You go up to the stall: cushioned saddles for dromedaries, climate-controlled baskets for snakes, nothing useful… except for a birdwatching kit with a call-whistle and some quality birdseed: perfect!
You take the whistle and the birdseed.

Page.Text: Along the main street you run into that show-off Aladdin, strutting about. He has a golden lamp dangling from his belt and a flashy sapphire ring on his finger.

Page.Text:
You pretend to trip and grab Aladdin's robes to keep from falling. Surprised, he puts out his arms to hold you up; quick as lightning you take his hand and slide the ring off: a master stroke. You apologise and take your leave.
Pleased with yourself, you examine the haul: the sapphire in the ring pulses with energy and an Efreet comes out of it, a magical spirit.
— Who disturbs me? What can I do for you? —
— Can you carry me to Ali Baba? —
— You are too heavy; I can only carry small objects —

You wrap your face in your keffiyeh so as not to be recognised and stop yourself.
— Here, take this card! You will need it —
You/he look at you in surprise, but you accept your own gift. You no longer have the hire card, and you walk off towards the bazaar.

Page.Text: Sadly, you did not manage to stop Ali Baba, who reaches the palace and reports what happened. The royal guards are mobilised and, within a few days, you and your companions are caught and thrown into the Sultan's dungeons to rot. Your adventure ends here.

You missed the handover of the subscription to your past self, causing a space-time paradox that destroys the universe. If it is any consolation, you can say you stopped Ali Baba, in a manner of speaking.

The moment you sound the call, a gigantic winged shape drops out of the sky and heads for you: it is a Roc, a bird of prey of gargantuan size. It seizes you in its mighty talons and carries you off to its nest.
You have earned a place of honour at tonight's dinner... as the main course.

The moment the call is sounded, a gigantic winged shape heads your way: it is a Roc, a bird of prey of gargantuan size. Drawn by the birdseed, it dives on Ali Baba, who comes to a sticky end.
You have saved your band and you can celebrate with your fellow thieves: congratulations!
